items.name: Cache
items.summary: Represents mutable scratch space used by regex engines during a search.

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.summary: Returns the heap memory usage, in bytes, of this cache.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new `Cache` for use with this regex.

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Reset this cache such that it can be used for searching with the given `Regex` (and only that `Regex`).

items.name: Config
items.summary: An object describing the configuration of a `Regex`.

methods.name: auto_prefilter
methods.summary: Toggles whether automatic prefilter support is enabled.

methods.name: backtrack
methods.summary: Toggle whether a bounded backtracking regex engine should be available for use by the meta regex engine.

methods.name: byte_classes
methods.summary: Whether to attempt to shrink the size of the alphabet for the regex pattern or not. When enabled, the alphabet is shrunk into a set of equivalence classes, where every byte in the same equivalence class cannot discriminate between a match…

methods.name: dfa
methods.summary: Toggle whether a fully compiled DFA should be available for use by the meta regex engine.

methods.name: dfa_size_limit
methods.summary: Sets the size limit, in bytes, for heap memory used for a fully compiled DFA.

methods.name: dfa_state_limit
methods.summary: Sets a limit on the total number of NFA states, beyond which, a full DFA is not attempted to be compiled.

methods.name: get_auto_prefilter
methods.summary: Returns whether automatic prefilters are enabled, as set by [`Config::auto_prefilter`].

methods.name: get_backtrack
methods.summary: Returns whether the bounded backtracking regex engine may be used, as set by [`Config::backtrack`].

methods.name: get_byte_classes
methods.summary: Returns whether byte classes are enabled, as set by [`Config::byte_classes`].

methods.name: get_dfa
methods.summary: Returns whether the DFA regex engine may be used, as set by [`Config::dfa`].

methods.name: get_dfa_size_limit
methods.summary: Returns DFA size limit, as set by [`Config::dfa_size_limit`].

methods.name: get_dfa_state_limit
methods.summary: Returns DFA size limit in terms of the number of states in the NFA, as set by [`Config::dfa_state_limit`].

methods.name: get_hybrid
methods.summary: Returns whether the hybrid NFA/DFA regex engine may be used, as set by [`Config::hybrid`].

methods.name: get_hybrid_cache_capacity
methods.summary: Returns hybrid NFA/DFA cache capacity, as set by [`Config::hybrid_cache_capacity`].

methods.name: get_line_terminator
methods.summary: Returns the line terminator for this configuration, as set by [`Config::line_terminator`].

methods.name: get_match_kind
methods.summary: Returns the match kind on this configuration, as set by [`Config::match_kind`].

methods.name: get_nfa_size_limit
methods.summary: Returns NFA size limit, as set by [`Config::nfa_size_limit`].

methods.name: get_onepass
methods.summary: Returns whether the one-pass DFA regex engine may be used, as set by [`Config::onepass`].

methods.name: get_onepass_size_limit
methods.summary: Returns one-pass DFA size limit, as set by [`Config::onepass_size_limit`].

methods.name: get_prefilter
methods.summary: Returns a manually set prefilter, if one was set by [`Config::prefilter`].

methods.name: get_utf8_empty
methods.summary: Returns whether empty matches must fall on valid UTF-8 boundaries, as set by [`Config::utf8_empty`].

methods.name: get_which_captures
methods.summary: Returns the capture configuration, as set by [`Config::which_captures`].

methods.name: hybrid
methods.summary: Toggle whether the hybrid NFA/DFA (also known as the "lazy DFA") should be available for use by the meta regex engine.

methods.name: hybrid_cache_capacity
methods.summary: Set the cache capacity, in bytes, for the lazy DFA.

methods.name: line_terminator
methods.summary: Set the line terminator to be used by the `^` and `$` anchors in multi-line mode.

methods.name: match_kind
methods.summary: Set the match semantics for a `Regex`.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new configuration object for a `Regex`.

methods.name: nfa_size_limit
methods.summary: Sets the size limit, in bytes, to enforce on the construction of every NFA build by the meta regex engine.

methods.name: onepass
methods.summary: Toggle whether a one-pass DFA should be available for use by the meta regex engine.

methods.name: onepass_size_limit
methods.summary: Sets the size limit, in bytes, for the one-pass DFA.

methods.name: prefilter
methods.summary: Overrides and sets the prefilter to use inside a `Regex`.

methods.name: utf8_empty
methods.summary: Toggles whether empty matches are permitted to occur between the code units of a UTF-8 encoded codepoint.

methods.name: which_captures
methods.summary: Configures what kinds of groups are compiled as "capturing" in the underlying regex engine.

items.name: Regex
items.summary: A regex matcher that works by composing several other regex matchers automatically.

methods.name: builder
methods.summary: Return a builder for configuring the construction of a `Regex`.

methods.name: captures
methods.signature: fn captures<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, input: I, caps: &mut Captures)
methods.summary: Executes a leftmost forward search and writes the spans of capturing groups that participated in a match into the provided [`Captures`] value. If no match was found, then [`Captures::is_match`] is guaranteed to return `false`.

methods.name: captures_iter
methods.signature: fn captures_iter<'r, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'r self, input: I) -> CapturesMatches<'r, 'h>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over all non-overlapping `Captures` values. If no match exists, then the iterator yields no elements.

methods.name: captures_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of capturing groups.

methods.name: config
methods.summary: Return a default configuration for a `Regex`.

methods.name: create_cache
methods.summary: Creates a new cache for use with lower level search APIs like [`Regex::search_with`].

methods.name: create_captures
methods.summary: Creates a new object for recording capture group offsets. This is used in search APIs like [`Regex::captures`] and [`Regex::search_captures`].

methods.name: find
methods.signature: fn find<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, input: I) -> Option<Match>
methods.summary: Executes a leftmost search and returns the first match that is found, if one exists.

methods.name: find_iter
methods.signature: fn find_iter<'r, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'r self, input: I) -> FindMatches<'r, 'h>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over all non-overlapping leftmost matches in the given haystack. If no match exists, then the iterator yields no elements.

methods.name: get_config
methods.summary: Returns the configuration object used to build this `Regex`.

methods.name: group_info
methods.summary: Return information about the capture groups in this `Regex`.

methods.name: is_accelerated
methods.summary: Returns true if this regex has a high chance of being "accelerated."

methods.name: is_match
methods.signature: fn is_match<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, input: I) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this regex matches the given haystack.

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.summary: Return the total approximate heap memory, in bytes, used by this `Regex`.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Builds a `Regex` from a single pattern string using the default configuration.

methods.name: new_many
methods.summary: Builds a `Regex` from many pattern strings using the default configuration.

methods.name: pattern_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of patterns in this regex.

methods.name: search
methods.summary: Returns the start and end offset of the leftmost match. If no match exists, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: search_captures
methods.summary: Executes a leftmost forward search and writes the spans of capturing groups that participated in a match into the provided [`Captures`] value. If no match was found, then [`Captures::is_match`] is guaranteed to return `false`.

methods.name: search_captures_with
methods.signature: fn search_captures_with(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: &Input<'_>, caps: &mut Captures)
methods.summary: This is like [`Regex::search_captures`], but requires the caller to explicitly pass a [`Cache`].

methods.name: search_half
methods.summary: Returns the end offset of the leftmost match. If no match exists, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: search_half_with
methods.signature: fn search_half_with(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: &Input<'_>) -> Option<HalfMatch>
methods.summary: This is like [`Regex::search_half`], but requires the caller to explicitly pass a [`Cache`].

methods.name: search_slots
methods.summary: Executes a leftmost forward search and writes the spans of capturing groups that participated in a match into the provided `slots`, and returns the matching pattern ID. The contents of the slots for patterns other than the matching pattern…

methods.name: search_slots_with
methods.signature: fn search_slots_with(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: &Input<'_>, slots: &mut [Option<NonMaxUsize>]) -> Option<PatternID>
methods.summary: This is like [`Regex::search_slots`], but requires the caller to explicitly pass a [`Cache`].

methods.name: search_with
methods.signature: fn search_with(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: &Input<'_>) -> Option<Match>
methods.summary: This is like [`Regex::search`], but requires the caller to explicitly pass a [`Cache`].

methods.name: split
methods.signature: fn split<'r, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'r self, input: I) -> Split<'r, 'h>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of spans of the haystack given, delimited by a match of the regex. Namely, each element of the iterator corresponds to a part of the haystack that *isn't* matched by the regular expression.

methods.name: splitn
methods.signature: fn splitn<'r, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'r self, input: I, limit: usize) -> SplitN<'r, 'h>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of at most `limit` spans of the haystack given, delimited by a match of the regex. (A `limit` of `0` will return no spans.) Namely, each element of the iterator corresponds to a part of the haystack that *isn't* matched…

methods.name: static_captures_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of capturing groups that appear in every possible match.

methods.name: which_overlapping_matches
methods.summary: Writes the set of patterns that match anywhere in the given search configuration to `patset`. If multiple patterns match at the same position and this `Regex` was configured with [`MatchKind::All`] semantics, then all matching patterns are…

methods.name: which_overlapping_matches_with
methods.signature: fn which_overlapping_matches_with(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: &Input<'_>, patset: &mut PatternSet)
methods.summary: This is like [`Regex::which_overlapping_matches`], but requires the caller to explicitly pass a [`Cache`].

items.name: Split
items.summary: Yields all substrings delimited by a regular expression match.

methods.summary: Returns the current `Input` associated with this iterator.

items.name: SplitN
items.summary: Yields at most `N` spans delimited by a regular expression match.
